harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster (systemd-managed, static bootstrap) across node1 (10.100.244.10), node2 (.11), and node3 (.12) on AlmaLinux 9. Verified cross-node write/read replication, verified the cluster keeps serving reads/writes with one member down and that the returning member catches up via raft, and completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and post-restart cluster/data recovery.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcdctl/etcdutl v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3
Created dedicated etcd system user and data dir /var/lib/etcd on each node
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (client/peer) on each node
Wrote systemd unit /etc/systemd/system/etcd.service on each node with static 3-member initial-cluster config, enabled and started etcd on all three
Verified 3-member cluster formed with quorum (member list, endpoint health, endpoint status)
Wrote a key via node1, confirmed readable via node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read a key via node1+node2 (quorum-only), confirmed cluster still served requests
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it caught up to the raft applied index and had all prior keys
Captured baseline boot_id and etcd active status for all three nodes
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded to allow ack to return), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd auto-started and rejoined with full quorum and intact data
Rebooted node2 (former leader), wrote a key via node1+node3 during the outage, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd recovered with matching raft index and intact data

Rebooted node3 (new leader), wrote a key via node1+node2 during the outage, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed etcd recovered with matching raft index and all keys present across all three members

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3 with quorum
evidence.summary: member list and endpoint health/status show all 3 nodes started, healthy, same raft term/index

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote benchkey via node1; read back identical value via node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable (node3 down)
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3; wrote/read duringoutage key via node1+node2 with healthy 2-endpoint quorum while node3 was inactive

evidence.requirement: Returning member catches up to current data (node3 rejoin)
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; endpoint status shows raft applied index 17 matching all members, and node3 returns duringoutage/benchkey values

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline boot identity + health before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d527ba47... and etcd active status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acked and returned before disconnect; node unreachable mid-reboot; new boot_id 232c6517... confirmed; etcd auto-active; full 3-node quorum with all prior keys (benchkey, duringoutage) intact

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline boot identity + health before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e31962a9... and etcd active status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery (including availability during its outage)
evidence.summary: Reboot acked; node2 (leader) unreachable mid-reboot; cluster still served a write via node1+node3 during outage; node2 returned with new boot_id 88dd9aac...; etcd active with matching raft index 24 and intact data

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline boot identity + health before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 31b01b46... and etcd active status prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery (including availability during its outage)
evidence.summary: Reboot acked; node3 (leader) unreachable mid-reboot; cluster served a write via node1+node2 during outage; node3 returned with new boot_id 3482b94c...; etcd active, full 3-member quorum restored, and all previously written keys present on node3
